title: Vizio TV won't turn on
shortDescription: TV unresponsive with no standby light.
fullDescription:
Vizio TVs commonly fail to power on due to PSU capacitor failures, particularly on the M and E series. Symptoms include clicking sound or completely dead TV.

Recent SmartCast models also occasionally suffer firmware corruption that prevents boot.

fixSteps.title: Capacitor inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Open back, look for bulged caps on PSU.

videoSearchQuery: Vizio TV no power capacitor fix

faq.a: Reliability varies by series; PSU caps are a common 3-5 year failure point.

title: SmartCast home screen frozen
shortDescription: TV boots but SmartCast home doesn't load.
fullDescription:
Vizio SmartCast can freeze on its loading splash, often after firmware updates. Signing out of accounts and a hard reset typically resolves it.

For older models, SmartCast occasionally needs to be redirected through SmartCast Mobile setup again.

fixSteps.title: Factory reset
fixSteps.instruction: Menu > System > Reset & Admin > Reset to Factory Defaults.

faq.a: All apps, accounts, and Wi-Fi - you'll need to set up again.

title: HDMI input shows no signal
shortDescription: TV not detecting source on HDMI port.
fullDescription:
Vizio TVs show 'No Signal' when source is off, cable is loose, or the wrong input is selected. Some V/M series have known HDMI handshake issues with PS5 and Xbox Series X.

Firmware updates have fixed many of these handshake problems.

fixSteps.title: Switch input
fixSteps.instruction: Press Input on remote, select correct HDMI.

videoSearchQuery: Vizio TV no signal HDMI fix

faq.a: Yes on M and P series with HDMI 2.1; needs Ultra High Speed cable.

title: Netflix network error on Vizio
shortDescription: Netflix can't establish connection to servers.
fullDescription:
NW-3-6 means Netflix detects internet but can't fully connect to its servers. Most cases are local network issues; sometimes Vizio's SmartCast needs a reboot to refresh connections.

Does not indicate hardware fault.

faq.q: Will it affect my Netflix profile?
faq.a: No - it's a connection issue only.

title: TV plays picture but no audio
shortDescription: Internal speakers or audio output not working.
fullDescription:
Vizio audio issues are commonly caused by Audio Output set to External, Atmos passthrough enabled to a non-Atmos device, or a faulty internal amplifier on older E-series.

Setting output to PCM resolves most app-related audio failures.
symptoms: Volume bar moves but no audio
whenToCallPro: If software fixes fail - hardware issue.

faq.a: If TV outputs Atmos to a non-Atmos device, audio drops - use PCM.

title: Vizio HDMI-CEC failure
shortDescription: Devices don't auto-power or respond to TV remote.
fullDescription:
Vizio's CEC implementation works with most brands but is sensitive to firmware updates that disable it. The setting is simple: System > CEC > Enable.

Check this after every firmware update if CEC was working previously.

fixSteps.title: Set Device Discovery
fixSteps.instruction: Same menu - Device Discovery to detect devices.

faq.q: Does Vizio CEC work with Roku?
faq.a: Yes - Roku supports HDMI-CEC for power and input.

title: Vertical lines across screen
fullDescription:
Vertical lines on Vizio sets indicate T-CON or panel failure. Common on E and M series after 4-5 years of use.

Reseating ribbon cables sometimes resolves; otherwise board or panel replacement needed.

fixSteps.title: Test multiple inputs
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm lines on every input including menu.

faq.a: Often not - get a quote first.

title: Vizio remote not working
fullDescription:
Vizio remotes are mostly IR-based with newer models adding Bluetooth for voice. IR remotes need clear line of sight to the TV's lower bezel sensor.

The SmartCast Mobile app provides a backup remote.

fixSteps.title: Reset remote
fixSteps.instruction: Remove batteries, hold any button 15 seconds, reinsert.

faq.a: Lower-center bezel - confirm not blocked by soundbar.

title: Firmware update did not install
fullDescription:
SmartCast updates can fail due to network issues or storage. Vizio doesn't offer USB updates to users - if OTA fails persistently, contact support.

Network reset usually resolves transient failures.

faq.q: Can I install firmware via USB?
faq.a: No - Vizio does not provide user-installable firmware.

title: Black screen with audio - backlight failure
fullDescription:
Backlight failure on Vizio LCDs is common after 5+ years. The LED strips inside the panel burn out, leaving a dark screen with working audio.

The flashlight test confirms diagnosis. Repair requires panel disassembly.

fixSteps.title: Flashlight test
fixSteps.instruction: Shine flashlight at screen - faint image confirms backlight failure.

fixSteps.title: Backlight repair
fixSteps.instruction: LED strip replacement; panel disassembly required.

whenToCallPro: Backlight repair almost always pro work.

faq.a: Often not - on 32-43 inch sets, repair cost approaches replacement.

title: Netflix NETFLIX U7361-1253
shortDescription: Netflix app shows error NETFLIX U7361-1253 on Vizio TV, usually DRM-related.
fullDescription: Error NETFLIX U7361-1253 indicates a DRM problem between the Netflix app and its servers. Most cases clear with a sign-out, app reload, or network reset. Persistent errors may need firmware update or factory reset.

causes.cause: Stale app cache or expired session token
Outdated TV firmware or app version

fixSteps.title: Restart TV
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug TV for 60 seconds then power back on to clear memory.

fixSteps.title: Sign out and back in
fixSteps.instruction: Open Netflix, sign out, then sign back in to refresh the session token.

fixSteps.title: Check network
fixSteps.instruction: Run network test in TV settings; reboot router if speeds are low.

fixSteps.title: Update firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Support > Software Update; install any pending update.

fixSteps.title: Reinstall app
fixSteps.instruction: Remove the Netflix app from the home screen and reinstall from the store.

whenToCallPro: Only if errors persist after factory reset.

faq.q: Is NETFLIX U7361-1253 a TV hardware fault?
faq.a: No — it is an app/network error and clears with sign-out, reinstall, or firmware update.

title: HDMI black screen with audio
shortDescription: HDMI handshake/HDCP failure on Vizio TV; toggle HDMI Color Subsampling.
fullDescription: HDMI BLACK SCREEN indicates the TV failed to negotiate HDCP/EDID with the connected source. Common with 4K/120 Hz, eARC receivers, and long passive cables. Cycle power on both devices and try a certified Premium High Speed HDMI 2.1 cable.

causes.cause: HDCP handshake failure between source and TV
Source set to output unsupported format (4K120, Dolby Vision)
eARC/CEC conflict with AVR in chain

symptoms: Black screen with audio or no signal

fixSteps.title: Power-cycle the chain
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug TV, source, and AVR for 2 minutes; plug TV in first, then source.

fixSteps.title: Swap HDMI cable
fixSteps.instruction: Use a certified Ultra High Speed HDMI 2.1 cable under 2m.

fixSteps.title: Try a different HDMI port
fixSteps.instruction: Move source to another HDMI input; label the port for 4K/120 if needed.

fixSteps.title: Match source output
fixSteps.instruction: Set the source to 4K60 RGB to test, then raise resolution/refresh.

fixSteps.title: Toggle Enhanced Format
fixSteps.instruction: TV settings > External Inputs > HDMI Signal Format > Enhanced.

whenToCallPro: Replace HDMI board if multiple ports fail with a known-good cable.

faq.a: For 4K120/VRR/eARC, only certified Ultra High Speed HDMI 2.1 cables reliably pass the handshake.

title: SmartCast Home Won't Load
shortDescription: SmartCast Home shows blank screen or spinner.
fullDescription: SmartCast pulls its layout from Vizio servers. A DNS issue or stale cache leaves Home blank. A network reset usually restores it.

fixSteps.title: Reset network
fixSteps.instruction: Menu > Network > Reset Network Settings then reconnect.

faq.a: SmartCast Home shows blank screen or spinner.

title: Voice Remote Pairing Lost
shortDescription: Voice button fails on Vizio voice remote.
fullDescription: Voice remote uses Bluetooth for the mic. Re-pair by holding Input + Mute for 5 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Input + Mute 5 seconds until LED blinks.

faq.q: What causes VOICE REMOTE NO RESPONSE?

title: eARC Handshake Failure
shortDescription: AVR loses Atmos / DTS:X over eARC.
fullDescription: Vizio eARC requires CEC enabled and an AVR firmware that matches eARC spec. Toggling eARC and updating both ends typically fixes it.

faq.a: AVR loses Atmos / DTS:X over eARC.

title: Backlight Bleed / Uneven
shortDescription: Bright patches in corners or banding on dark scenes.
fullDescription: Local-dimming TVs show some clouding; firmware updates and reseating the back-cover screws often reduce it. Severe blooming on QLED suggests a failed local dimming zone.

causes.cause: Backlight assembly stress from over-tight screws
Local dimming algorithm needs firmware update

fixSteps.title: Loosen back screws
fixSteps.instruction: Remove rear cover screws by 1/4 turn.

whenToCallPro: Failed LED zone needs panel replacement.

faq.a: Bright patches in corners or banding on dark scenes.
